description: Shortest successful rollout among ten fixed seeds (1010-1019); not a statistical benchmark.

animation.view: observer ground truth with gray overlay on team-unexplored cells
animation.map_style: original geometry under 15% gray overlay; grid lines above overlay
animation.unobserved_occupancy: visible to viewer under gray overlay; not supplied to agents
animation.intro: Initial robot poses on an all-unknown map, before first sensing; not an extra rollout step.
animation.moving_obstacle_visibility: recorded displacement styling; gray squares are visually tinted under the observer overlay
animation.dynamic_obstacle_style: gray square during a recorded moving interval; ordinary occupancy when stationary
animation.motion_indicator: position changes from state t to t+1; false at the terminal state
animation.occupancy: the recorded shared map is retained for policy inputs; observer view adds display-only terrain
animation.gif_source: Native Pogema static SVG frames rasterized with CairoSVG; Pillow encodes GIF only.
animation.scope: Visualization adapter for recorded VORL states, not a replacement with Pogema simulation physics. Observer view is display-only.
